'''Orobird''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, flightless [[Bird/Legends|avians]] that was populous throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A [[Sentience/Legends|particularly simple-minded]] species, orobirds nevertheless thrived on numerous worlds, baffling [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] as to how they survived despite the fact that they were easy prey for predators and poachers due to their low intelligence, bright plumage and general loudness. Orobirds' meat was particularly foul-tasting, although some wealthy highbrows insisted the taste is an acquired one.<ref name="Codex" />

Orobirds had only two developed limbs with two digits on each, and a prominent beak. In the wild, adult orobirds were an aggressive species and possessed a brutish temperament.<ref name="Codex" />

==History==
[[File:OrobirdNest.png|left|thumb|Nest of a Giant Rishi Orobird located on a [[Horizon Island]]]]
The most common subspecies of orobirds, native to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], was '''Giant Rishi Orobird''', also known as '''Tropical Orobird'''.<ref name="tropical" /> The creatures built nests out of grass, but often left them unattended, not defending their eggs against predators and hunters who used found orobird eggs as a bait for [[Shaclaw|Giant Rishi mud crabs]].<ref name="Beach Bounty">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Beach's Bounty|[[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]}}</ref> By the time of the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]], Giant orobirds were considered an endangered species.<ref name="Giant Orobird Spleen">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=item|Giant Orobird Spleen|[[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]]}}</ref>

Giant Rishi Orobirds were trainable, and could be used for riding.<ref name="tropical">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=other|"Tropical Orobird" mount from [[Cartel Market]]}}</ref> A number of other breeds suited for riding existed, sold as mounts throughout the Galaxy; these included ''Fawn Orobird'', ''Jewelled Orobird'' and ''Onyx Orobird'', all with different feather colorings. <ref name="Cartel">[[Cartel Market|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Cartel Market]]</ref> 

Orobirds could be confused with multiple similar looking species which were often kept as pets. These included ''Orosquab ''and ''Orokeet'', native to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] and [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]],<ref name="Egg Hatching">{{TORcite|type=other|Achievement "Egg Hatching"}}</ref> as well as ''Orochick ''and ''Crested Orokeet'', differentiated from all other birds of this group by its head-crest.<ref name="Vendors">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Pets sold by Fleet vendors}}</ref>
